body:
OWNER AUTHORITY REQUEST — successor reconciliation for already-landed candidate.

Current fixed Mote binary 87cf55f... restores all legacy evidence/reviews. Git proves cand-1EE04B commit 77e62ef is already in main. Sherlock cand-6XWW is reviewed, chief-authorized, and now blocked only by ancestor cand-1EE04B. Current candidate reconcile permits only original immutable authorizer claude-storymodel4s, who is absent. Existing successor-authorizer containment applies only to supersede and would falsely record already-landed work as superseded.

Please choose one explicit policy:
A. Require claude-storymodel4s to return and perform ordinary landed_out_of_band reconciliation; or
B. Authorize a separately reviewed Mote protocol for owner/successor-chief reconciliation of already-landed candidates. Minimum contract: exact same-repository target reachability plus complete containment evidence; current-phase and evidence CAS; preserve original policy snapshot, approve/block reviews, and absence of authorization; record the forcing actor, owner authority, reason, evidence IDs, target SHA, and phase landed_out_of_band; no impersonation and no approval carryover.

No live candidate mutation will occur until this authority is explicit and the chief scopes the implementation/court.
